outline:
本課程係培養師資生運用資訊科技輔助教學及學生學習的基本素養，透過概念的介紹、範例的觀摩、以及實地的操作，讓學生瞭解利用資訊科技輔助教學的準備、過程、以及可能面對的議題。具體目標：（一）瞭解資訊科技輔助教學及數位學習相關理論；（二）發展認識及挑選教學及學習資源的能力；（三）發展資訊科技輔助教學之電腦實務能力；（四）瞭解資訊科技輔助教學當前趨勢與倫理等議題。
教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結:
https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
The purpose of this course is to let students understand how to make teaching material for every different course. The contents of this course include how to make transparency, slide, and video tape. Furthermore, MS Office PowerPoint will be introduced in this class.
Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link:
https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

resources:
● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration)
運用生成式AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS等新興科技輔助教學與評量。
Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
aiUsage: ● 使用生成式AI作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）
